title: Privileged role multi-factor policy is report-only

messages.businessImpact: Administrators look protected in the console while the policy only records what it would have required. A phished administrator password still gets through.
messages.technicalDetail: A policy counts when it covers privileged roles the same way CAD-005 does, requires multi-factor authentication, and is left in report-only mode, while no enabled policy requires multi-factor authentication or an authentication strength of the same administrators.
remediation: Review the report-only results for the named roles, resolve the accounts that would be blocked, then set the policy to On.
messages.cannotSee: Phishing-resistant strength is CAD-008. A report-only policy that uses OR with an alternative to MFA is not counted here, because MFA is not mandatory on that policy. A report-only policy kept beside an enforced one, usually to trial something stricter, is left alone.
